description: The ready-made menus, toolbar, handles, panels and cards of every bundled edytor plugin, in shadcn-svelte components and tokens.

<script lang="ts">
	import { Button } from '$UI$/button/index.js';
	import { words } from './words.svelte.js';
	import type { BlockHandleSnippetPayload } from 'edytor';

	/**
	 * Notion's block handle, drawn for `blockHandles={{ handle }}`: the `+`
	 * (Alt+click adds above, or a column beside a block in a column) and the
	 * ⋮⋮ grip (drag, click for the block menu, Alt+arrows).
	 */
	let { handle }: { handle: BlockHandleSnippetPayload } = $props();
	const { block, grip, plus } = $derived(handle);
	const labels = $derived(words.blockHandles);
</script>

<Button
	variant="ghost"
	class="edytor-block-add"
	contenteditable="false"
	hidden={handle.readonly}
	data-testid="block-add"
	aria-label={handle.beside ? labels.addBeside(handle.label) : labels.add(handle.label)}
	title={handle.beside ? labels.addBesideHint : labels.addHint}
	{@attach plus}
>
	<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
		<path
			d="M8 2.75v10.5M2.75 8h10.5"
			fill="none"
			stroke="currentColor"
			stroke-width="1.4"
			stroke-linecap="round"
		/>
	</svg>
</Button><Button
	variant="ghost"
	class="edytor-block-handle"
	contenteditable="false"
	hidden={handle.readonly}
	data-testid="block-handle"
	data-block-id={block.id}
	aria-label={labels.grip(handle.label)}
	data-draggable={handle.draggable ? 'true' : undefined}
	{@attach grip}
>
	<svg viewBox="0 0 10 16" width="10" height="16" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
		<circle cx="2.5" cy="3" r="1.3" />
		<circle cx="7.5" cy="3" r="1.3" />
		<circle cx="2.5" cy="8" r="1.3" />
		<circle cx="7.5" cy="8" r="1.3" />
		<circle cx="2.5" cy="13" r="1.3" />
		<circle cx="7.5" cy="13" r="1.3" />
	</svg>
</Button>

<style>
	:global(.edytor-block-handle),
	:global(.edytor-block-add) {
		display: inline-flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: center;
		width: 24px;
		height: 24px;
		padding: 0;
		border: 0;
		border-radius: 6px;
		background: transparent;
		color: var(--muted-foreground);
		cursor: pointer;
		transition: background-color 80ms ease;
	}

	:global(.edytor-block-handle) {
		width: 18px;
	}

	/* Over a gap between two columns, the `+` is compact (the handle spans the gap). */
	:global([data-edytor-block-handle-host][data-over-gap='true']) :global(.edytor-block-add) {
		width: 18px;
	}

	:global(.edytor-block-handle[data-draggable='true']) {
		cursor: grab;
	}

	:global(.edytor-block-handle[hidden]),
	:global(.edytor-block-add[hidden]) {
		display: none;
	}

	:global(.edytor-block-handle:hover),
	:global(.edytor-block-handle:focus-visible),
	:global(.edytor-block-add:hover),
	:global(.edytor-block-add:focus-visible) {
		background: var(--accent);
		outline: 0;
	}

	:global(.edytor-block-handle[data-draggable='true']:active) {
		cursor: grabbing;
	}

	:global(.edytor-block-handle svg) {
		fill: currentColor;
	}
</style>

<!--
	The demo's chrome: the Notion-style markup of every menu, popup, handle,
	panel and card, as the snippets the plugins take (the package ships the
	controllers and draws none of it). The demo route, the `/test/*` routes
	and the DOM tests pass these (`plugins.ts`); the docs' examples are the
	short versions. Each snippet renders a component of this folder, which
	holds its markup and its styles (a module's own snippets carry no styles).
-->
<script module lang="ts">
	import type {
		BlockHandleSnippetPayload,
		BlockMenuController,
		CalloutIconPicker,
		CodeHeader as CodeHeaderController,
		CommentCardPayload,
		CommentsController,
		EquationEditor,
		FindController,
		ImageToolbar as ImageToolbarController,
		LanguageMenu as LanguageMenuController,
		MarqueeBoxPayload,
		MediaEmptyController,
		MentionItem,
		PageLinkItem,
		SlashMenuController,
		SuggestionBarPayload,
		TableAddPayload,
		TableChrome as TableChromeController,
		TableGripPayload,
		ToolbarController,
		TriggerMenuController,
		UrlPasteController
	} from 'edytor';
	import BlockHandle from './BlockHandle.svelte';
	import BlockMenu from './BlockMenu.svelte';
	import CalloutIcons from './CalloutIcons.svelte';
	import CodeHeader from './CodeHeader.svelte';
	import CommentCard from './CommentCard.svelte';
	import CommentsHeader from './CommentsHeader.svelte';
	import EquationPanel from './EquationPanel.svelte';
	import FindBar from './FindBar.svelte';
	import ImageToolbar from './ImageToolbar.svelte';
	import LanguageMenu from './LanguageMenu.svelte';
	import LinkCard from './LinkCard.svelte';
	import MarqueeBox from './MarqueeBox.svelte';
	import MediaEmpty from './MediaEmpty.svelte';
	import MentionMenu from './MentionMenu.svelte';
	import PageLinkMenu from './PageLinkMenu.svelte';
	import SlashMenu from './SlashMenu.svelte';
	import SuggestionBar from './SuggestionBar.svelte';
	import TableChrome from './TableChrome.svelte';
	import Toolbar from './Toolbar.svelte';
	import TriggerMenu from './TriggerMenu.svelte';
	import UrlPasteMenu from './UrlPasteMenu.svelte';

	export {
		slashMenu,
		triggerMenu,
		mentionMenu,
		pageLinkMenu,
		blockMenu,
		toolbar,
		linkCard,
		urlPasteMenu,
		codeHeader,
		languageMenu,
		calloutIcons,
		tableGrip,
		tableMenu,
		tableAdd,

		imageToolbar,
		mediaEmpty,
		blockHandle,
		commentCard,
		commentsHeader,
		findBar,
		suggestionBar,
		marqueeBox
	};
</script>

/**
 * The ready-made chrome (the `edytor-chrome` registry item): each bundled
 * plugin drawn with it, its snippets (`chrome`), its words and the version
 * history panel. The files are yours: edit them.
 */
export {
	chrome,
	slashMenu,
	slashMenuPlugin,
	blockMenu,
	blockMenuPlugin,
	toolbar,
	toolbarPlugin,
	blockHandles,
	blockHandlesPlugin,
	code,
	codePlugin,
	table,
	tablePlugin,
	equation,
	image,
	imagePlugin,
	imageToolbarPlugin,
	embed,
	embedPlugin,
	bookmark,
	bookmarkPlugin,
	richText,
	richTextPlugin,
	calloutIcons,
	calloutIconsPlugin,
	find,
	findPlugin,
	arrowMovePlugin,
	suggestionsPlugin,
	suggestionBarPlugin,
	comments,
	mention,
	pageLink,
	file,
	filePlugin,
	video,
	videoPlugin,
	audio,
	audioPlugin,
	mediaEmptyPlugin,
	marquee,
	marqueePlugin
} from './plugins.js';
export {
	words,
	setWords,
	englishWords,
	type ChromeWords,
	type PartialChromeWords
} from './words.svelte.js';
export { default as HistoryPanel } from './HistoryPanel.svelte';

/**
 * Notion's palette, as the demo's toolbar offers it: each name's text colour
 * and background (`Default` none), the CSS values the toolbar's colour marks
 * store. The block colours (`BLOCK_COLORS`) are the same names, lowercase,
 * painted by the theme's tokens with these as fallbacks.
 */
export const PALETTE = [
	{ name: 'Default', text: null, background: null },
	{ name: 'Gray', text: '#7d7a75', background: '#f0efed' },
	{ name: 'Brown', text: '#9f765a', background: '#f5ede9' },
	{ name: 'Orange', text: '#d27b2d', background: '#fbebde' },
	{ name: 'Yellow', text: '#cb9434', background: '#f9f3dc' },
	{ name: 'Green', text: '#50946e', background: '#e8f1ec' },
	{ name: 'Blue', text: '#387dc9', background: '#e5f2fc' },
	{ name: 'Purple', text: '#9a6bb4', background: '#f3ebf9' },
	{ name: 'Pink', text: '#c14c8a', background: '#fae9f1' },
	{ name: 'Red', text: '#cf5148', background: '#fce9e7' }
] as const;

/**
 * The demo chrome's words: what its menus, bars, panels and cards show and
 * say (the package's own words, the kinds' names and the document's, are
 * the view's `labels`). English by default; `setWords` replaces any entry
 * of any section (a nested group's entries alone), `setWords()` restores
 * English. The chrome reads `words` reactively.
 */

/** A byte count is the package's (`media.fileSize`); these are the chrome's. */
const english = {
	slashMenu: {
		filter: 'Type to filter…',
		filterLabel: 'Filter block commands',
		list: 'Block commands',
		noResults: 'No results',
		close: 'Close menu',
		closeKey: 'esc',
		/** A section heading, by its group key; others show as they are. */
		groups: {
			'Basic blocks': 'Basic blocks',
			'Advanced blocks': 'Advanced blocks',
			Media: 'Media',
			Layout: 'Layout',
			Color: 'Color',
			Inline: 'Inline'
		} as Record<string, string>
	},
	toolbar: {
		bar: 'Text formatting',
		text: 'Text',
		turnInto: 'Turn into',
		link: 'Link',
		linkUrl: 'Link URL',
		linkPlaceholder: 'Paste link',
		apply: 'Apply',
		applyLink: 'Apply link',
		remove: 'Remove',
		removeLink: 'Remove link',
		color: 'Color',
		textColor: 'Text color',
		backgroundColor: 'Background color',
		/** A palette color's name, by its `PALETTE` name. */
		colors: {} as Record<string, string>,
		colorText: (color: string) => `${color} text`,
		colorBackground: (color: string) => `${color} background`,
		card: 'Link',
		open: 'Open',
		openLink: 'Open link in a new tab',
		edit: 'Edit',
		editLink: 'Edit link'
	},
	blockMenu: {
		search: 'Search actions…',
		searchLabel: 'Search actions',
		menu: 'Block actions',
		block: 'Block',
		turnInto: 'Turn into',
		color: 'Color',
		textColor: 'Text color',
		backgroundColor: 'Background color',
		noResults: 'No results'
	},
	blockHandles: {
		add: (kind: string) => `Add a block below ${kind} (Alt: above)`,
		addBeside: (kind: string) => `Add a block below ${kind} (Alt: a column to the right)`,
		addHint: 'Click to add below\nAlt-click to add a block above',
		addBesideHint: 'Click to add below\nAlt-click to add a column to the right',
		grip: (kind: string) => `${kind} block: drag to move, click for actions`
	},
	/** A trigger's menu: one that names nothing, the mention's, the page link's. */

	mention: { menu: 'People', searching: 'Searching…', noResults: 'No results' },
	pageLink: { menu: 'Pages', searching: 'Searching…', noResults: 'No results' },

export type ChromeWords = typeof english;

/** The English words (a copy is `words` until `setWords`). */
export const englishWords: ChromeWords = english;

/** The entries of each section to replace (a nested group's entries alone). */
export type PartialChromeWords = {
	[K in keyof ChromeWords]?: {
		[P in keyof ChromeWords[K]]?: ChromeWords[K][P] extends (...args: never[]) => unknown
			? ChromeWords[K][P]
			: ChromeWords[K][P] extends object
				? Partial<ChromeWords[K][P]>
				: ChromeWords[K][P];
	};
};

/** The chrome's words now (reactive). */
export const words: ChromeWords = $state(structuredCloneWords(english));

/** A copy of `source` (its functions shared). */
function structuredCloneWords<T>(source: T): T {
	if (typeof source !== 'object' || source === null) return source;
	return Object.fromEntries(
		Object.entries(source).map(([key, value]) => [key, structuredCloneWords(value)])
	) as T;
}

/** Replace any entry of `words` (`partial`'s nested groups merged); none: English again. */
export const setWords = (partial?: PartialChromeWords) => {
	const fresh = structuredCloneWords(english) as Record<string, Record<string, unknown>>;
	for (const [section, entries] of Object.entries(partial ?? {}))
		for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(entries ?? {})) {
			const own = fresh[section]![key];
			fresh[section]![key] =
				own && typeof own === 'object' && value && typeof value === 'object'
					? { ...own, ...value }
					: value;
		}
	Object.assign(words, fresh);
};
